header.title: New prescription
header.subSignedFull: This prescription has been signed and can be delivered to the patient.
header.sub: Standard CFM layout. ICP-Brasil signature inside the platform or external.

issuer.warningPrefixHtml: Heads up: profile data missing to issue a complete prescription: {{missing}}.

form.heading: Prescription data
form.noPrescriptionMsg: Your professional council does not allow prescriptions — contact support.
form.medPosologiaPlaceholder: E.g.: 1 tablet in the morning, for 30 days
form.obsPlaceholder: E.g.: take after meals; avoid driving in the first days.
form.quantidadeHint: Total units (boxes/packages) the pharmacy can dispense across all visits. E.g.: 2 boxes → patient may pick 1 today and 1 later.
form.qtyRequired: Enter the total prescribed quantity (1 to 24).

tipoLabels.mipHint: Over-the-counter medications. No stripe, free dispensing.
tipoLabels.insumoHint: COFFITO Ruling 735/2024 — physiotherapists may prescribe supplies and injectables within scope.
tipoLabels.controladoHint: Special-controlled medications (red stripe — C1/C5). Clinical validity 30 days. Psychotropics B1/B2 (blue) and A1/A2/A3 (yellow) still require physical prescription pad.

preview.emptyHtml: Fill in the data and click Generate PDF to preview.

sign.title: Sign the prescription
sign.a1IntroHtml: Upload your .pfx file (A1 certificate) and password. Signing happens in your browser — the file never leaves your device.
sign.extIntroHtml: Download the PDF, sign wherever you prefer (gov.br, BirdID, Adobe + A1, etc.) and re-upload. Suggestions: gov.br/assina (free) · BirdID · Receita Digital CFM.

delivery.title: Prescription signed
delivery.linkHelperPharmacy: . The pharmacy opens the link to validate the signature.
delivery.signedSub: Share the link below with the patient. The pharmacy opens the same link to validate.
